title: vaultTeardown
responsibility: Plans the ordered Credential Vault lease teardown and its security log checks.

inputs.name: vaultTeardown.input
inputs.description: Recipe teardown settings, whether a browser was used, and the lease start and end times.

outputs.name: vaultTeardownLimits
outputs.description: Time allowed to finish teardown and the delay of the second security log check.

outputs.name: vaultTeardown
outputs.description: Ordered teardown steps with deadlines, ending in two security log checks or an unverifiable flag.
